title: Instant Decaffeinated Coffee, Pre‑lightened and Pre‑sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener, Ready to Reconstitute

content.title: About
content.content: This instant decaffeinated coffee is made from selected beans that undergo decaffeination, pre‑lightening and the addition of a low‑calorie sweetener. After drying and granulation the product is ready to be reconstituted with hot water.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water‑process or CO₂ extraction, preserving most flavor compounds.
Pre‑lightening reduces bitterness and yields a smoother taste.
Low‑calorie sweeteners such as stevia or erythritol provide sweetness without added sugar.
Instant coffee retains up to 70 % of the original brew’s aromatic compounds.
Packaging often comes in single‑serve sachets, ideal for travel and office use.

items.title: Low caffeine content
items.content: The absence of caffeine makes it suitable for people sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: Reconstituting with hot water helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Low‑calorie sweetener
items.content: Stevia and erythritol contribute virtually no calories, aiding energy‑balance control.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that provide antioxidant activity even after processing.

items.title: Convenience and time saving
items.content: Quick preparation without grinding beans saves time in a busy schedule.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to coffee components.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some low‑calorie sweeteners can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts.

items.title: Loss of aroma compounds
items.content: Drying and granulation reduce the amount of aromatic substances compared with freshly ground coffee.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Add one sachet (≈2 g) to hot water (80‑90 °C) and stir for 30‑60 seconds. Optionally add milk, cream, or spices such as cinnamon or cardamom.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package, protected from moisture and direct sunlight. Shelf life is typically 12‑24 months.
